WeirdML v1". The current published release identifier is v3, so this row silently reuses an outdated version identity with an active/published status. This violates criterion c1's continuity requirement.
findings.repair: Update the row to the current WeirdML v3 identity, metric and description, or explicitly model this board as the retired/superseded v2 board and change status/version_status to retained rather than active/published v2.

findings.evidence: Row metric says "Average Max Accuracy: per task, mean over runs of the maximum test accuracy across the 5 iterations per run, averaged over all 17 tasks" and description mentions PyTorch code with fixed compute/time limits. SOURCE 1 says the official score is "80% normalized area under its line on a logarithmic token axis, plus 20% of its final value", covers "11 tasks", "15 configurations", and does not mention 5 iterations, max test accuracy, 17 tasks, or PyTorch/fixed compute/time. The protocol excerpt therefore contradicts the row's metric and description. Unit/range [0,100] percent is not contradicted by SOURCE 3's observed scale (lowest 1.729411764705882, highest 93.57264705882352).
findings.repair: Align metric and description with the v3 protocol scoring definition and task/config counts, or supply the actual v2 protocol excerpt and use its exact scoring rule, task count and description.

findings.evidence: Row has version 2, status "active", version_status "published" and superseded_by null, while SOURCE 1 presents "WeirdML v3" as current and calls v2 a previous version. That names v3 as the successor for a v2 board, so superseded_by:null is inconsistent when the row is for v2. SOURCE 2's activity summary is affirmative for current reporting activity but does not identify which version it applies to and cannot cure the version/supersession conflict.
findings.repair: If this row is for v2, set superseded_by to our registry id for WeirdML v3 and select consistent lifecycle fields (retained unless fresh v2-specific reporting is evidenced); if it is for v3, change version/version_guard and identity accordingly.
